subject: Pricing attachment missing
text: I’m reaching out about your lawn care service. I checked the quote you sent, but the attachment with pricing options seems missing. Could you resend it when you get a sec? I’m trying to figure out whether the monthly plan or a one-off deep clean is a better fit for our side yard. Also, do you have any discounts for neighbors on the same street? I’d be grateful if you could resend the missing file before I decide, so we can maybe get your crew over next weekend, please.
